_comment: INCOMPLETE BY DESIGN. Only fixed-date national holidays are listed here,
because those are the only ones that can be stated without consulting the
exchange circular. Most Indian market holidays follow lunar calendars
(Holi, Diwali/Laxmi Pujan, Eid, Gurunanak Jayanti, ...) and their dates
change every year. Inventing them would be worse than leaving them out:
the system would believe the market is open when it is closed.
ACTION REQUIRED: replace `complete: false` with the full list from the
official NSE holiday circular for each year, then set `complete: true`.
The calendar raises a health warning while a year is marked incomplete.
